pack.name: Official Writing / Analysis / Instruction Following
pack.description: Small writing tasks reviewed against explicit human criteria rather than fabricated automatic scores.

benchmark.name: Writing and Analysis Essentials
benchmark.description: Human-reviewed writing quality under explicit length, audience, evidence, and structure constraints.

tasks.name: Write a constrained risk summary
tasks.prompt: Write for a busy non-specialist. Follow every length and audience instruction, distinguish facts from recommendations, and do not invent evidence.

cases.prompt: Summarize this situation in 80 words or fewer for a product manager: a release passed unit tests, but the staging database was half the production size and no rollback rehearsal was recorded. Include one factual risk and one practical next step.

tasks.name: Write a structured decision memo
tasks.prompt: Produce a concise memo with the requested headings. Make tradeoffs explicit, keep recommendations proportional to the evidence, and avoid claiming work that was not performed.

cases.prompt: Write a memo with exactly these headings: Decision, Evidence, Risks, Next step. Recommend whether a small local-first desktop tool should add cloud sync in its first release when no threat model, account system, or backup design exists. Keep it under 180 words.

criteria.name: Instruction following
criteria.description: Meets requested audience, length, headings, and content constraints.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Communicates a coherent answer in direct, readable language.

criteria.name: Evidence discipline
criteria.description: Separates known facts from recommendations and does not invent evidence.

criteria.name: Practical usefulness
criteria.description: Offers a proportionate next step or decision that a reader can act on.

execution.requirement: Text generation only; output quality is reviewed against the declared human rubric and no automatic writing score is implied.
